name: breadcrumb
purpose: WAI-ARIA APG Breadcrumb: a labelled <nav> with an ordered list of links to the current page's ancestors, the current page marked with aria-current, optional collapsing behind an expander, validated hrefs, and a cancelable navigate event for client-side routers.
whenToUse: Hierarchical sites or apps where users benefit from seeing and jumping to ancestor pages.
Deep pages reached from search or links, to show where the page sits.
whenNotToUse: Flat sites with one or two levels.
Showing browsing history (breadcrumbs show hierarchy, not the path taken).
responsive: Items wrap onto multiple lines; long labels break (overflow-wrap: anywhere). Use maxItems to collapse long trails on small screens.
rtl: Logical layout follows the document direction. The chevron separator is mirrored when direction is rtl (configured) or the element is in an rtl context (:dir(rtl)).
theme: Links use color-link with an underline; the current page uses color-text and medium weight; separators use color-text-muted. Forced-colors mode uses LinkText and a ButtonText border on the expander.
security: Labels are rendered with textContent. Hrefs are parsed with the URL standard against document.baseURI; only http(s) and scheme-less (relative, path-absolute, query, fragment) URLs are accepted, so javascript:, data:, and other schemes are rejected with a configuration error that does not echo the value. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Navigation is native link navigation unless aui-navigate is prevented.

performance.testedScale: Trails of up to 6 items in the unit tests.

limitations: Collapsing is by item count (maxItems), not by measured width.
An expanded trail stays expanded until the items change.
unsupported: Dropdown menus of collapsed items (the expander reveals them in place).
Hrefs with schemes other than http and https.
antiPatterns: Linking the current page (keep linkCurrent false unless the page has distinct sub-states).
Using breadcrumbs as the only navigation.
Truncating labels so ancestors become ambiguous.
